**Q3.2**

```{r}
# create design plan framework
design.plan<-data.frame(
  RPM=c("1","2","3","4","5"),
  r  =c(5,3,5,2,5)
)
design.plan

# assign/derive necessary parameters
N  <- sum(design.plan$r) #Number of EUs = sum of r's

set.seed(123) #for reproducibility of sample function

# creates data table of random permutations from 1 to N 
dat<-data.frame(
  EU=sample(1:N) 
)
dat

# create/factor RPM
dat$RPM<-rep(design.plan$RPM, times=design.plan$r)
dat$RPM<-as.factor(dat$RPM)
dat
dat$RPM

#Sort by EU if desired
dat <- dat %>% arrange(EU)
dat

#Verify trt replication count
xtabs(~RPM,data=dat)
```
